title: astracantha thracica subsp. cyllenea
intro: Astracantha thracica subsp. cyllenea, commonly known as a type of Astragalus plant, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Astracantha thracica subsp. cyllenea include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and supporting the immune system. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
